why: V4-NAMES-1: every Intel D and E v4 size (Dv4, Dsv4, Ddv4, Ddsv4, Ev4, Esv4, Edv4, Edsv4, with the constrained and isolated sizes), and every Intel D and E size on v5, v6 and v7 (no AMD and no Arm64 size), so a test can run each v4 size against the sizes Azure really offers. Trimmed to the capabilities the planner reads. Restrictions are emptied: they belong to the subscription that read the catalog, not to the region.
command: az vm list-skus -l centralus --resource-type virtualMachines --all -o json
